name: Femi Maringka
bio: Eufemia Evanesa Maringka is an Indonesian content creator, comedy influencer, theater actress, and voice actor. She initially gained widespread recognition as one of the key founders and talents behind the popular comedy group Trio Reog.

credits.title: People Pleaser: Si Paling Gak Enakan
credits.overview: Karina is a young woman who always puts others first and finds it difficult to say "no." This habit leaves her exhausted and causes her to sacrifice her own dreams.

credits.title: A Bowl of Chicken Noodles Before I Die
credits.overview: If today were your last day, what one small thing would you really want to do?  For Ale, the answer is simple: enjoy a bowl of his favorite chicken noodles before he truly gives up on life. But when his regular food cart is closed, that situation leads him into a series of unexpected encounters.
